{{Quote|I'll thank you to keep a civil '''audio-amplifier''' in your '''housing dome!'''|C-3PO|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 18">[[Star Wars (1977) 18|''Star Wars'' (1977) 18]]</ref>}}
An '''audio-amplifier''' was a component of [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]]. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] though [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2's]] audio-amplifier was being used in an uncivil and insulting manner during a mission.
